instruction.text: Ordne den Adverbialsätzen die passenden Beispielsätze zu.

atoms.b: I started learning English when I was 10 years old.
I started learning English because I want to visit America.
I started learning English although it is not easy.

instruction.text: Ordne den Adverbialsätzen die passenden Beispielsätze zu.

atoms.b: People speak English everywhere I go.
I am so good at English that I can help my friends.
I need to learn English so that I can understand English songs.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Konjunktion im Satz.

atoms.b: It's good to know you're by my side ((wherever)) I go.

instruction.text: Um welche Art von Adverbialsatz handelt es sich?
Tippe auf die Konjunktion im Satz.

atoms.b: ((Although)) she studied a lot, she didn't get the grade she wanted.

instruction.text: Um welche Art von Adverbialsatz handelt es sich?
Tippe auf die Konjunktion im Satz.

atoms.b: Victoria goes for a run every morning ((so that)) she can run a marathon next year.

instruction.text: Um welche Art von Adverbialsatz handelt es sich?

atoms.b: It was so cold outside ((++that because)) we played inside the house.
It started to snow ((++when so)) he arrived at school.
My parents can't help me with my homework ((++as therefore)) they don't know how to solve it either.

instruction.text: Ergänze die Regel, indem du das richtige Satzende auswählst.
Welche Satzstellung benötigt ein Komma? Ziehe es an die richtige Stelle.

wrong.text:
